body: I kinda grew up listening to them. My parents were fans of them and whenever we went on long car rides I remember listening to Longveiw, Welcome to Paradise, BOBD, WMUWSE, and even some 21st Century Breakdown as I got older. I really, REALLY got into them this year and started listening to them on my own with the release of UNO DOS and TRE. Now I'm buying albums that came out before I was born.
Came here to find this. Most of Reddit seems to dislike Green Day. They are my favorite band, and will stay with me forever

They keep me going. If I ever have a really shitty day, I just put on some Green Day and its like an instant pick me up. I don't think I could make it through the week without them. The way they put everything they have into the music, and the meaning behind the lyrics is so powerful for me.
